taskQueue.name: Implement Task Item Component
taskQueue.description: Create TaskItem component to display individual tasks with toggle completion status and delete functionality.

taskQueue.name: Implement Task List Component
taskQueue.description: Create TaskList component to render tasks based on current filter (all, completed, incomplete). Integrate TaskItem components.

taskQueue.name: Implement Task Filter Component
taskQueue.description: Create TaskFilter component with buttons to filter tasks by status (all, completed, incomplete). Update TaskList view based on selected filter.

taskQueue.name: Integrate Application Components
taskQueue.description: Create App.tsx as main application component integrating TaskInput, TaskList, TaskFilter components. Implement state management using useState for tasks and filter state. Create src/index.tsx as application entry point.

taskQueue.name: Final Integration & Verification
taskQueue.description: Verify all features from specification are fully implemented: task creation, task display, task completion toggle, task deletion, task filtering (all/completed/incomplete), proper state management, Tailwind CSS styling. Check for missing components, incomplete functionality, or gaps. Ensure the complete Simple Tasks application works as intended.
